canonical_source.scope: Immutable source-custody origin; later recipe/proof-only commits may advance the PR head.

historical_status_note: QUALIFICATION.json and SOURCE_ORIGINS.json are unchanged qualification-time records. Their pending-publication fields describe the earlier observation; this intake supplies the actual source origin after publication.
rights: Retain per-file headers and origin-specific rights/provenance records. Existing M3Scale rights references remain attached through the earlier five-file intake.
qualification_scope: Exact source custody, fixed point, partial-order and refusal checks. This intake does not claim semantic correctness or performance of the recovered donor implementations.
sdk_refusal_boundary: Content-drift and mode-drift trials each produce three SDK candidate changes including two relocations before the recorded error; the harness discards the entire errored run and writes no rejected candidate. The SDK itself is not asserted transactional.
